Standard: Impulse noise levels measured at the chest at each crew station are less than 195 dBP IAW MIL-STD-1474, Impulsive Noise Non-auditory Effects Criteria paragraph, unless specific analysis is performed to assess the risk of blast lung (and other internal organ) injury (e.g., analysis IAW 9.5.1.4). Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Test.
(1) Lab test: Sound pressure levels are measured during system-level tests IAW MIL-STD-1474, Impulsive Noise Non-auditory Effects Criteria paragraph.
